posts.text: Ever wonder what goes into bringing K/DA to the tabletop? Brice Cox, Creative Director of Riftbound, shares how the team brought the Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection to center stage and explores the creativity, artistry, and passion behind the stunning artwork with Fortiche! The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection drawing…
The show continues at Nexus Night! Keep an eye out for the new alternate art cards in your #RBRadiance Nexus Night packs!

K/DA is ready to take the stage in your collection. Celebrate their comeback with the Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection, featuring cards with art by Fortiche, exclusive items inspired by K/DA, and the FIRESTARTER KiT! Sign up for the drawing before it closes: https://riot.com/3QYxPVC

The first-ever Riftbound Regional Championship: Europe kicks off next month in Stuttgart! Get ready for the region’s biggest event yet with our Know Before You Go guide. Article: https://riot.com/4yHrXjD

Riftbound is coming to Lucca Comics & Games 2026 starting tomorrow! 🇮🇹 Stop by our booth from October 28–November 1 to demo Riftbound and pick up exclusive event merch while supplies last. See you there!

The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection brings K/DA to life through all-new artwork from Fortiche, the animation studio behind the FIRESTARTER music video and Arcane. Go behind the scenes with Fortiche artist Romain Mazevet as he shares how Evelynn’s new look came to be. The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture…

The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection drawing is LIVE! Enter now through October 30, 9AM PT for your chance to get your hands on this limited-edition bundle! Drawing Registration: https://riot.com/3QYxPVC
